score_observations: Inspected legend explicitly defines harmonics,slap,breath with pitch,key noise,bisbigliando in measured/free rhythm,quarter tones and multiphonic fingerings. Legend states score written in C.

Opening printedp5 alternates accented thirty-second-note runs(quarter66)and soft expressive irregular tuplet figures(quarter54),with frequent meter/tempo changes,quarter-tone accidentals,trills and bisbigliando. Dynamics at least pp–ff. Only opening inspected; no global range claimed.
